questions: How many oxidized or etched CsV3Sb5 devices did you make beyond Devices 11 to 14, and did any of them show no field-free diode response? (The ten pristine devices are counted in Table S1 and the Ti-doped Devices 15 and 16 in Figs. S13 and S14.) Could you also confirm the device labels: p. 5 gives the -30.86% and 17.07% sweeps as Device 12 (Figs. S3 to S5), Fig. S4 labels them Device 13, and Fig. S3 calls Device 12 "Fig. 2 in the main text" while Fig. 2 shows Device 11.

Your supplementary text (p. 2) says only one sweep in three showed a diode at the second and fourth oxidation stages. Were any sweeps, cooldowns or devices set aside from the statistics in Figs. 3d&e and 4, and why?

Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: field steps near zero in Fig. 4, fields beyond 0.2 T, temperatures other than 1.8 K for the oxidized devices, and temperatures below 1.8 K for the pristine devices?
What do the zero-field statistics of your second-best device (Device 14, or the oxidized Device 12) look like next to Fig. 3d&e?

What is the residual field at the sample at nominal zero in the PPMS and in the Triton, after the in-plane sweeps to 10 T (Figs. S1, S2) and the 1 T field cools (Figs. S8, S9), and was it measured or compensated?

The training fields of 0.1 to 0.2 T are a sizable fraction of the out-of-plane critical field of about 0.85 T (Fig. S10), where vortices and Meissner screening currents are present. Did you measure the diode efficiency against out-of-plane field on a pristine device and on the etched Ti-doped Device 16?

For the null results, how many sweeps did you take per condition on the pristine devices and on Devices 15 and 16, at which temperatures relative to their Tc, and what are the Tc and critical current of the Ti-doped devices? With a diode in one sweep out of three in Device 11, a few sweeps could miss it.

At zero field, is the mean signed efficiency (with its uncertainty) different from zero, and how do the separate distributions of |Ic+| and |Ic-| compare? In Fig. S4, |Ic+| alone ranges from 16.8 to 36 μA between sweeps, and it would help to know how the onset was located in multi-peak curves such as Fig. 2c.
